description: This file manages the document head elements in a Next.js application, including rendering React elements to DOM, updating head tags dynamically, and initializing head management logic.

methods.name: reactElementToDOM
methods.description: Converts a React JSX element into a DOM HTMLElement, setting attributes and inner content accordingly.

methods.name: updateElements
methods.description: Updates specific head elements (meta, link, style, script) in the document head based on provided React components.

methods.name: initHeadManager
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object managing head elements, including a method to update the head based on React JSX elements.
